statusLine.command: input=$(cat); cwd=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir'); name=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.session_name // empty'); rem=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.remaining_percentage // empty'); dir=$(basename "$cwd"); branch=$(git -C "$cwd" branch --show-current 2>/dev/null); dirty=$(git -C "$cwd" diff-index --quiet HEAD -- 2>/dev/null || echo '*'); parts=""; [ -n "$name" ] && parts="$(printf '\033[38;5;147m%s\033[0m' "$name") "; parts="$parts$(printf '\033[38;5;183m%s\033[0m' "$dir")"; [ -n "$branch" ] && parts="$parts $(printf '\033[38;5;221m%s\033[0m' "$branch")$( [ -n "$dirty" ] && printf ' \033[38;5;208m*\033[0m' )"; [ -n "$rem" ] && parts="$parts $(printf '\033[38;5;246m%s%%\033[0m' "$rem")"; echo "$parts $(printf '\033[38;5;48m>\033[0m')"
